More than three decades later, in 1995, as a private citizen he stepped in to help fund New York’s Veterans Day parade (the “Nation’s Parade” marking the 50th anniversary of the end of World War II). 

Facing a funding shortfall, organizers received a significant donation from Trump, reported at $200,000, along with additional fundraising support he helped generate. He also marched in the parade that year.
